strings.name: Maria Ressa
strings.summary: Born in Manila and raised in the United States, Princeton graduate Ressa worked in Southeast Asian television news. She co-founded Rappler, investigated abuses of power and studied social-media disinformation. She shared the 2021 Nobel Peace Prize with Muratov. She has faced several legal cases; her cyberlibel conviction remained under appeal, and government lawyers recommended acquittal in 2026, a recommendation rather than a ruling.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded a news organisation and studies disinformation’s effects on democracy; received the Nobel Peace Prize for defending freedom of expression.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Investigative journalism
strings.highlights.h1.text: Co-founded Rappler to report on power abuses and information manipulation.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Nobel Peace Prize
strings.highlights.h2.text: Shared the 2021 award with Dmitry Muratov for defending freedom of expression.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Government lawyers urge acquittal
strings.timeline.t1.text: The solicitor general cited prescription in recommending reversal of cyberlibel convictions, not a final ruling.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Nobel Peace Prize
strings.timeline.t2.text: Shared the award with Muratov for defending freedom of expression.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Cyberlibel conviction
strings.timeline.t3.text: A Manila court convicted her; she continued judicial appeals.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Co-founded Rappler
strings.timeline.t4.text: Helped build digital journalism combining reporting and social-media analysis.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Led television news
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became head of ABS-CBN news and later left the organisation.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined CNN
strings.timeline.t6.text: Reported in Southeast Asia and later led overseas bureaus.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Princeton graduation
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed undergraduate study before research and journalism in the Philippines.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in Manila
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved to the United States in childhood, later working across both countries.
